hooks.name: Check schemas after a table change
hooks.description: After a save to schemas.py or the data-contracts steering file, ask the agent to run the schema tests and say which table needs a version bump. Enforced for real by tests and pre-commit.

action.prompt: schemas.py or the data-contracts steering file was just saved. Run `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_schemas.py -q` and `uv run computers schema check`. If a table's columns changed, say which table, confirm its version was raised, and regenerate with `uv run computers schema lock` and `uv run computers schema docs`. Do not regenerate the lock to hide a missing version bump.
